# Dr. Rajeev Agarwal — Fertility Specialist & Gynaecologist, Kolkata

> Dr. Rajeev Agarwal is a leading fertility specialist and gynaecologist in Kolkata with 25+ years of experience in IVF, IUI, laparoscopy, PCOS, and women's health, practising at Renew Healthcare. This site covers his services, structured preconception counselling ("The Zero Trimester"), patient education, success stories, and appointment booking (in-person and virtual).

## Key pages
- [Home](https://drrajeevagarwal.co.in/): Overview of Dr. Rajeev Agarwal's fertility and gynaecology practice in Kolkata.
- [About Dr. Rajeev Agarwal](https://drrajeevagarwal.co.in/about-me): 25+ year journey in fertility medicine — training, awards, publications, and patient-first philosophy at Renew Healthcare.
- [All Services](https://drrajeevagarwal.co.in/all-services): Full range — IVF, IUI, laparoscopy, hysteroscopy, PCOS management, menopause care, fertility preservation, and more.
- [Preconception Counselling — The Zero Trimester](https://drrajeevagarwal.co.in/preconception): Structured preconception care — fertility tests, genetic screening, PCOS, thyroid, vaccination, and lifestyle optimisation for both partners.
- [Perimenopause & Menopause Care](https://drrajeevagarwal.co.in/menopause-care): Patient education hub — symptoms, a scored symptom quiz, HRT/MHT explained, tests, diet and exercise, and the multidisciplinary care team.
- [Health Blog](https://drrajeevagarwal.co.in/blog): Evidence-based articles on fertility, pregnancy, PCOS, menopause, IVF, and women's health.
- [Book an Appointment](https://drrajeevagarwal.co.in/book-an-appointment): Schedule an in-person or virtual consultation at Renew Healthcare, Kolkata.

## Perimenopause & menopause care
- [Menopause Care hub](https://drrajeevagarwal.co.in/menopause-care): Where the transition sits in the timeline, why the 40s are the decade to act, and where to go next.
- [Perimenopause Symptoms & Quiz](https://drrajeevagarwal.co.in/menopause-care/perimenopause-symptoms-quiz): The 18 symptoms that signal perimenopause, plus a free five-minute quiz that scores the pattern by body system (cycle, vasomotor, sleep, mood, cognition, metabolic, musculoskeletal, genitourinary). Correlation tool, not a diagnosis.
- [HRT / MHT Guide](https://drrajeevagarwal.co.in/menopause-care/hrt-hormone-therapy): What hormone therapy is, what the 2002 WHI trial actually showed and its limitations, who it suits, oral vs transdermal routes, duration, risks in absolute terms, and non-hormonal alternatives.
- [Tests & Diagnostics](https://drrajeevagarwal.co.in/menopause-care/tests-and-diagnostics): Thyroid, FSH and estradiol, HbA1c and insulin resistance, lipids and hs-CRP, DEXA, vitamin D, Pap smear and mammography — what each rules in or out, plus ASCVD/QRISK3 and US MEC 2024.
- [Diet, Exercise & Lifestyle](https://drrajeevagarwal.co.in/menopause-care/diet-exercise-and-lifestyle): Blood-sugar stability, 25-30g protein per meal, resistance and impact training for bone, supplements worth discussing, and a BMI and waist check.
- [Menopause Care Team](https://drrajeevagarwal.co.in/menopause-care/care-team): Gynaecology (Dr. Rajeev Agarwal, clinical lead), metabolic medicine, mental health counselling, exercise medicine, clinical nutrition and genetics.
- [Menopause Articles & Videos](https://drrajeevagarwal.co.in/menopause-care/articles-and-videos): Video library and written articles on perimenopause, menopause and hormone therapy.
